Hi Lisa — thanks for the details and the PO. Quick answers up front:

1) Delivery options: we support (a) portal-first delivery (preferred), (b) SFTP push, and (c) email PDF push.
2) VAT & PO: we can include a line-item VAT breakdown and the PO number on the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata for API/webhook consumers.

Given your internal review timeline, I suggest the following pragmatic sequence so payments aren't delayed:
- We invite your AP team to the Redwood Billing Portal (recommended). That gives structured invoice history and machine-readable export.
- While you evaluate the portal (up to 30 days), we will enable email push copies to ap@acmecorp.com and a secondary AP mailbox if you provide one.
- We can also enable an immediate SFTP drop if your security team prefers it.

Action items for you: please confirm the preferred temporary email copy address (if different), the billing contact name for payment reconciliation, and whether you need signed PDFs. Once confirmed, we will:
- Send a portal invite to your billing contact,
- Configure email pushes for each invoice (starting with the one for PO-77821), and
- Flag invoices with the reverse-charge VAT note per your request.

I’ve looped in Kimberly (billing operations) and Ben (payments) to action the portal invite and email push.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
